{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print(f"Number of unique patient_id after deduplication: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Check assay_batch: batch B reports in µg/L
# But 1 µg/L = 1 ng/mL, so no conversion needed
# Batch A is already in ng/mL
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df_dedup['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# No unit correction needed: batch B values are already in ng/mL (µg/L = ng/mL)
# So we can directly compute the mean of biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

print(f"Mean biomarker_final (after deduplication, no unit correction): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
